title: Recover a Faulted AGV Carrying a Tote (RMS stop → Hospital HMI remove → re-add → resume RMS)
summary: When an AGV is faulted while carrying a tote, stop RMS, remove the faulted AGV from RMS, remove the AGV via the Hospital HMI, add the AGV back into RMS, press E-stop again, and resume RMS.
when_to_use: Use this recovery procedure when an AGV is faulted while carrying a tote and you need to restore normal RMS operation by removing the faulted AGV from RMS, removing it at the Hospital HMI, re-adding it to RMS, and resuming RMS.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Executes the RMS stop/E-stop, performs AGV removal and re-add actions in the RMS AGV API Controls area, removes the AGV at the Hospital HMI, then resumes RMS.
safety_notes: This procedure includes pressing E-stop on RMS (twice: before removal and after re-adding).
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the “AGV API Controls” controls referenced by the manual
Access to the “Starting the System” controls referenced by the manual

access_required: rms_ui access to perform RMS E-stop and use AGV API Controls
hospital_hmi access to use the Hospital HMI Add/Remove AGV screen
system_preconditions: An AGV is faulted while carrying a tote (Faulted AGV with Tote scenario).

visual_references.description: Figure 5-4: Faulted AGV with Tote Screen (fault recovery sequence reference).
Figure 4-37: Hospital HMI Add/Remove AGV Screen (used to remove/add an AGV via Hospital HMI).
Figure 4-12: AGV API Controls (Remove AGV / Recover AGV / Pause All AGVs / Resume All AGVs controls).

steps.title: E-stop RMS
steps.purpose: Stop RMS movement before removing the faulted AGV and tote handling at the Hospital.
steps.instruction: On the RMS / fleet status UI, perform an E-stop for RMS.
steps.expected_result: RMS is in an E-stopped state (E-stop RMS action is applied on the RMS UI).
steps.healthy_condition: RMS is stopped (E-stop RMS state active) so you can safely remove the faulted AGV from RMS.
steps.failure_condition: RMS is not stopped (E-stop RMS action does not take effect), preventing safe removal/recovery actions.
stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot place RMS into the E-stop state, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 5.8.2.4: FAULTED AGV WITH TOTE: 1. E-stop RMS.

steps.title: Remove the faulted AGV from RMS
steps.purpose: Remove the faulted AGV from RMS so it can be handled at the Hospital.
steps.instruction: On the RMS / fleet status UI, use the “AGV API Controls” controls to remove the faulted AGV from RMS (enter the AGV ID and use the Remove AGV action).
steps.expected_result: The faulted AGV is removed from the system via the AGV API Controls Remove AGV action.
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV is no longer present/active in RMS after the Remove AGV action (as reflected by the RMS AGV management view).
steps.failure_condition: The AGV cannot be removed from RMS using AGV API Controls (removal action does not succeed).

actions.label: Remove AGV (AGV API Controls)
actions.exact_action: Remove AGV An AGV can be removed from the system by entering the AGV ID.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the faulted AGV cannot be removed from RMS.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 5.8.2.4: FAULTED AGV WITH TOTE: 2. Remove AGV from RMS. (See "AGV API Controls" on page 24.)
Figure 4-12: AGV API CONTROLS — Remove AGV: An AGV can be removed from the system by entering the AGV ID.

steps.title: Remove the AGV at the Hospital HMI
steps.purpose: Physically take the tote to the Hospital and remove the AGV via the Hospital HMI.
steps.instruction: Take the tote to the Hospital and remove the AGV via the Hospital HMI using the “Add/Remove AGV” screen.
steps.expected_result: The AGV is removed from the system at the Hospital via the Hospital HMI Add/Remove AGV screen.
steps.healthy_condition: Hospital HMI Add/Remove AGV workflow completes for the AGV being removed (AGV removal action executed on the screen).
steps.failure_condition: Hospital HMI does not successfully remove the AGV.

actions.label: Remove AGV (Hospital HMI Add/Remove AGV)
actions.exact_action: The "Add/Remove AGV Screen" is used to add a removed AGV to the system or remove an AGV from the system.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the Hospital HMI does not successfully remove the AGV.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 5.8.2.4: FAULTED AGV WITH TOTE: 3. Take the tote to the Hospital and remove the AGV via the Hospital HMI. (See "1.7 Add/Re- move AGV" on page 52.)
Figure 4-37: Hospital HMI Add/Remove AGV Screen — used to add a removed AGV to the system or remove an AGV from the system.

steps.title: Add the AGV back into RMS
steps.purpose: Reintroduce the recovered AGV into RMS so fleet operation can resume.
steps.instruction: On the RMS / fleet status UI, use the “AGV API Controls” controls to add the AGV back into RMS (enter the AGV ID and use the Recover AGV action).
steps.expected_result: The AGV is added back into the system via the AGV API Controls Recover AGV action.
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV is present/active in RMS after the Recover AGV action (as reflected by the RMS AGV management view).
steps.failure_condition: The AGV cannot be added back into RMS using AGV API Controls.

actions.label: Recover AGV (AGV API Controls)
actions.exact_action: Recover AGV Enter an AGV ID to add it to the system.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if RMS cannot be resumed after re-adding the AGV.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 5.8.2.4: FAULTED AGV WITH TOTE: 4. Add AGV into RMS. (See "AGV API Controls" on page 24.)
Figure 4-12: AGV API CONTROLS — Recover AGV: Enter an AGV ID to add it to the system.

steps.title: Press E-stop again on RMS
steps.purpose: Apply the E-stop again after re-adding the AGV, per the fault recovery sequence.
steps.instruction: On the RMS / fleet status UI, press E-stop again on RMS.
steps.expected_result: RMS E-stop is pressed again (E-stop RMS action applied a second time).
steps.healthy_condition: RMS remains in the E-stopped state after the second E-stop press, consistent with the recovery sequence.
steps.failure_condition: Second E-stop press does not take effect.
stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot apply the second E-stop, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 5.8.2.4: FAULTED AGV WITH TOTE: 5. Press the E-Stop again.

steps.title: Resume RMS
steps.purpose: Resume normal RMS operation after the faulted AGV has been removed, handled at the Hospital, and re-added.
steps.instruction: On the RMS / fleet status UI, resume RMS using the “Starting the System” procedure controls.
steps.expected_result: RMS resumes after the faulted AGV has been removed from RMS, removed at the Hospital HMI, and re-added into RMS.
steps.healthy_condition: RMS is running again (system resumes operation) following the recovery sequence.
steps.failure_condition: RMS cannot be resumed after re-adding the AGV.

actions.label: Resume RMS
actions.exact_action: Resume RMS. (See "Starting the System" on page 65.)

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if RMS cannot be resumed after re-adding the AGV.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 5.8.2.4: FAULTED AGV WITH TOTE: 6. Resume RMS. (See "Starting the System" on page 65.)

success_criteria: RMS is resumed after the faulted AGV has been removed from RMS, removed via the Hospital HMI, and re-added into RMS.
healthy_conditions: RMS is running again after the recovery sequence completes.
The faulted AGV has been removed from RMS, removed at the Hospital HMI, and re-added into RMS.
failure_conditions: RMS cannot be resumed after re-adding the AGV.
The Hospital HMI does not successfully remove the AGV.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if RMS cannot be resumed after re-adding the AGV, or if the Hospital HMI does not successfully remove the AGV.
